\[
\begin{gathered}
K_{\text{normal}} = \frac{1}{2} \begin{bmatrix} -1 & -1 & -1 \\ -1 & 10 & -1 \\ -1 & -1 & -1 \end{bmatrix},
\quad
K_{\text{more}} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & -1 & -1 \\ -1 & 9 & -1 \\ -1 & -1 & -1 \end{bmatrix}
\end{gathered}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(K\): The 3 x 3 kernel

These are Pillow's EDGE_ENHANCE and EDGE_ENHANCE_MORE kernels. Both add up to 1, so flat areas keep their value. Each is the image plus a multiple of the 8-neighbor Laplacian with a positive center: half of it for normal, and all of it for more. That is Laplacian sharpening with a fixed amount.
